Ava (PM): heads-up — we need a concise API error matrix for chat/embeddings/rerank/function-calls/struct-output before GA. Customers are asking for clear retry semantics and launch criteria.

Jon (Eng): +1. I'll draft errors we return today and where we need changes. Focus: status codes, error body shape, retryable vs non-retryable, rate-limit headers.

Sasha (Support): Customers keep getting 429s with no Retry-After in some proxies. They escalate as "unclear". Also seeing 503 for model warmup with ambiguous messaging.

Ravi (Eng-ML): For model unavailable we often send 503. Proposal: 503 with code "model_unavailable" and field "estimated_retry_seconds" when we can predict. If unknown, include "retryable":true + Retry-After header.

Maya (SRE): Agree on Retry-After header. Also include standard X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, and X-RateLimit-Reset for throttling. Retry-After as integer seconds or HTTP date.

Jon (Eng): Draft error shapes — please comment.

Jon (Eng): ```json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "rate_limit",
    "message": "quota exceeded for project",
    "code": "rate_limit",
    "retry_after": 30,
    "details": {"scope":"per-minute"}
  }
}
```

Sasha (Support): include a short user-facing message and an internal code. Customers want the message to suggest mitigation (backoff/batching/caching).

Lee (ProdOps): For validation errors (bad prompt payloads) use 400 + code "validation_error" and include an array of field errors. These are non-retryable.

Ravi (Eng-ML): For model output validation/struct-output schemas we might return 422 (unprocessable) with code "output_validation_failed" and include a sample mismatch.

Ava (PM): Let's put launch criteria on this thread: must-have: clear 429 behavior + headers, 503 model_unavailable with guidance, 400 validation with field errors, 401/403 consistent for auth/perm, 422 for structured-output mismatch. Nice-to-have: estimated_retry_seconds from runtime, idempotency guidance, and standardized client error codes.

Jon (Eng): Prioritization suggestion: P0 (must ship): 429 headers + retry guidance, 400 field errors, 503 model_unavailable with retryable flag. P1: 422 structured output, standardized error codes list. P2: per-endpoint nuance docs and SDK helpers.

Maya (SRE): Add: gateway timeouts -> 504 with "downstream_timeout". Should be retryable with exponential backoff but cap at 2 retries for interactive latencies.

Sasha (Support): Example user-visible error we can ship:

Jon (Eng): ```json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "model_unavailable",
    "message": "Model temporarily unavailable in your region. Try again in ~30s or use a compatible model variant.",
    "code": "model_unavailable",
    "retryable": true,
    "estimated_retry_seconds": 30,
    "fallback_suggestion": ["gpt-small-v1","gpt-small-v1-quantized"]
  }
}
```

Lee (ProdOps): For Function/Tool calling: if function execution fails due to user-provided tool input, return 400 with code "tool_execution_error" and include tool name + tool error. If platform-side tool failure (timeout), 502/503 depending on cause.

Ravi (Eng-ML): Embeddings/rerank: heavy batch requests can be rate-limited differently. Recommend per-endpoint quota headers, e.g., X-RateLimit-Embedding-Limit. If we can't provide endpoint-specific header, include "scope" in error details.

Ava (PM): Scope negotiation: we'll aim to cover P0 items for initial GA of unified API surface. P1 in first minor release (2 weeks). Customers who asked (SaaS analytics, search teams) get early beta for 422 structured-output.

Jon (Eng): Action items: I'll open RFC with full matrix + example payloads and map SDK errors. Maya to define exact header names and backoff guidance. Sasha to curate top 10 support cases for wording. Ravi to add model-unavailable heuristics.

Maya (SRE): noted. I'll include expected latency thresholds for retry caps.

Sasha (Support): Anything about logging/error IDs? Customers want correlation-id in body.

Jon (Eng): Yes — include "request_id" in all error responses for debugging.

Ava (PM): Cool. If folks are okay, I'll mark this thread as the canonical spec pointer and use it in launch checklist. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: New RFC created: /rfc/api-error-matrix-1742543210 — Jon to update with final JSON shapes.

Jon (Eng): will update RFC by EOD. Thanks everyone.
